summary: ps-bool executes an obfuscated base85+zlib payload on import
details: The package's main.py consists of a single statement: exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b85decode('<~5KB blob>'))). The entire module body is an opaque, multi-layer-encoded payload that is decoded and executed whenever main is imported or the declared psbool console-script entry (psbool=main:main) is invoked. The package ships no other source, no README, and a near-empty PKG-INFO, so there is no declared legitimate functionality to justify the obfuscation. Both the sdist (ps_bool-0.2.4.tar.gz) and the wheel (ps_bool-0.2.4-py3-none-any.whl) contain this same main.py, so the behavior fires on default pip install across every supported platform as soon as the module is imported or the psbool CLI is run. The contents of the decoded payload are hidden from static review, giving whoever authored the blob arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
